text: The Lyse group, the parent of Lyse Tele and the Altibox brand, is owned by 15 municipalities in Southern Rogaland and Agder, with its headquarters in Stavanger.
short: Lyse AS is owned by 15 municipalities in Southern Rogaland and Agder.
